outcome: Neonatal motor and sensory neurobehavioral scores
Neurodevelopmental testing (open field, object recognition, T-maze, radial-arm maze)
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant rabbit does at 28 days of gestation and their offspring (pups).
finding: Maternal general anesthesia and laparotomy during late gestation in rabbits led to measurable neonatal neurologic impairment, slower motor development, and altered brain morphology, although these effects were largely resolved by 7 weeks of age.
